channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: Bikinis and booze: Garden Grove cafe had more on the menu than allowed, police say
item.description: Seventeen people were arrested after police said a coffee shop in Garden Grove was operating as a 'bikini cafe.'

item.title: L.A.'s warm stretch to end; cooler weather and showers are on the way, forecasters say
item.description: Cooler weather and showers are headed for Southern California starting Tuesday and continuing through the rest of the week. Monday will be the last day of a warm stretch.

item.title: Ex-cop wanted on murder charge flew overseas, lived in L.A. for a year without arrest
item.description: Former LAPD Officer Clifford Proctor was indicted in connection with a murder by an L.A. County grand jury in September 2024. He was able to leave the U.S. four times and live in Carson for more than a year before being taken into custody.

item.title: How Casey Wasserman entered Epstein’s orbit and why it might affect his role with the LA28 Olympics
item.description: Newly-released risque emails with Ghislaine Maxwell, longtime confidant of convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, threatens Casey Wasserman's role overseeing the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics Games.

item.title: By running for mayor, Nithya Raman will learn how left L.A. really is — or isn’t
item.description: On the last day of January, hundreds of people filled the pews of Immanuel Presbyterian Church in Koreatown to hear not the word of God but the gospel of the Democratic Socialists of America.

item.title: City of L.A. seeks to dump the federal judge overseeing a homelessness settlement
item.description: The City of Los Angeles is asking an appeals court to remove the federal judge overseeing a settlement that requires it to produce thousands of shelter beds and housing units and clear nearly 10,000 homeless camps from the streets.

item.title: Chappell Roan leaves Wasserman Music over exec's Epstein ties
item.description: Roan is the highest-profile act to leave Wasserman after the release of Epstein documents revealing his intimate relationship with child sex trafficker Ghislaine Maxwell.

item.title: Schiff endorses Swalwell for California governor
item.description: Sen. Adam Schiff (D-Calif.) has endorsed Rep. Eric Swalwell (D-Dublin) for California governor.

item.title: FBI says no suspects, no communication as Nancy Guthrie ransom deadline passes with no proof of life
item.description: Sources told The Times the ransom note felt credible because it included details about a specific damaged piece of property and the placement of an accessory in the home. The Times has not reviewed the note, but sources with knowledge of the investigation said it sought $6 million.
